headline: RBI: 15 States to raise ₹31,950 crore via SGS auction on Nov 23, 2026
summary_points: 15 State Governments have offered to sell stock by auction for an aggregate ₹31,950 crore (face value).
Auction on RBI's E-Kuber on Nov 23, 2026; competitive bids 10:30-11:30 AM, non-competitive 10:30-11:00 AM.
Results on Nov 23, 2026; payment by successful bidders on Nov 25, 2026. Minimum bid ₹10,000 in multiples of ₹10,000.
SGS investments count as SLR-eligible for banks under Section 24 of the Banking Regulation Act, 1949.
who_is_affected: Banks, primary dealers, insurers, mutual funds, provident funds and retail investors bidding in State Government Securities.
action_required: Eligible bidders should submit competitive or non-competitive bids on E-Kuber (or Retail Direct for individuals) within the stipulated timings on November 23, 2026.

social.linkedin:
RBI has announced the auction of State Government Securities for an aggregate ₹31,950 crore (face value), with 15 State Governments participating.

Key details:
- Auction date: November 23, 2026 (Monday) on RBI's E-Kuber system
- Competitive bids: 10:30 AM to 11:30 AM; non-competitive bids: 10:30 AM to 11:00 AM
- Results on the same day; payment by successful bidders on November 25, 2026
- Minimum nominal amount ₹10,000 and in multiples thereafter
- Up to 10% of the notified amount of each stock is reserved for non-competitive bidders, capped at 1% per single bid

The stocks are SLR-eligible for banks under Section 24 of the Banking Regulation Act, 1949, and qualify for the ready forward facility. Several tranches are re-issues of existing SGS, while others are yield-based auctions of new stock.

Treasury teams and investors should plan their bids and funding accordingly.

Please verify the details, including the state-wise schedule, with the official RBI press release.
